tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per bid document
Bidder shall quote landing cost per kwh which includes the charges mentioned in the section-7, clause 7.3, tariff/rate component.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: minimum Supply track record is detailed in tender Document section5, clause 5.2 technical Qualification criteria for each package and also refer package wise summery as detailed in Annexure -1 of bid document

The Bidder, either a Power Generating Company or Trading Licensee or Consortium, must demonstrate a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 171 crore for all 3 packages, i.e. Rs. 57crore for T.K. Halli, Rs. 57 crore for Harohalli, Rs. 57 crore for Tataguni over the preceding three financial years (i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), certified by a Chartered Accountant
